FR-001.statement: Customers should be able to register and log in securely.

FR-002.statement: Customers should be able to search and filter products by category, brand, price range, and rating.

FR-003.statement: Customers should be able to view real-time product details, specifications, customer reviews, and stock availability.

FR-004.statement: Customers should be able to add products to a persistent shopping cart and modify item quantities.

FR-005.statement: Customers should be able to save items to a personal wishlist for future purchase.

FR-006.statement: Customers should be able to proceed through a multi-step checkout selecting delivery address and shipping options.

FR-007.statement: Customers should be able to pay for orders securely using credit cards, digital wallets, or net banking.

FR-008.statement: Customers should receive immediate email and SMS confirmation upon successful order placement.

FR-009.statement: Customers should be able to view their complete order history and real-time shipment tracking status.

FR-010.statement: Customers should be able to request an order cancellation or return within the eligible return window.

FR-011.statement: Customers should be able to submit product reviews and star ratings after receiving their order.

FR-012.statement: Vendors should be able to register, verify their business profile, and log in securely.

FR-013.statement: Vendors should be able to create, update, and manage their product catalog listings.

FR-014.statement: Vendors should be able to set base prices, promotional discounts, and SKU inventory quantities.

FR-015.statement: Vendors should receive notifications when new orders containing their items are placed.

FR-016.statement: Vendors should be able to view pending orders and acknowledge fulfillment readiness.

FR-017.statement: Vendors should be able to view sales analytics, revenue breakdowns, and settlement reports.

FR-018.statement: Warehouse staff should be able to manage inventory stock levels across regional warehouses.

FR-019.statement: The system should automatically reserve stock items when an order checkout begins.

FR-020.statement: The system should release reserved stock if payment is not completed within 15 minutes.

FR-021.statement: Warehouse staff should be able to generate packing slips, assign barcode labels, and mark orders as packed.

FR-022.statement: Warehouse staff should be able to dispatch packages and update carrier tracking numbers.

FR-023.statement: The system should notify inventory managers when stock for any SKU falls below safety threshold.

FR-024.statement: The system should integrate with payment gateways for authorized card processing and refund disbursement.

NFR-001.statement: All transactions must enforce PCI-DSS compliant tokenization and never store raw card numbers.

FR-025.statement: The system should generate tax invoices and itemized receipts for every completed order.

FR-026.statement: The system should process refunds automatically when a customer return request is approved.

FR-027.statement: Payment failures or gateway timeouts should be recorded and prompt the customer to retry without duplicating orders.

FR-028.statement: Support agents should be able to look up customer accounts, orders, and delivery timelines.

FR-029.statement: Support agents should be able to initiate replacement requests or manual coupon credits.

FR-030.statement: Administrators should be able to manage user roles, merchant approvals, category taxonomies, and fee structures.

FR-031.statement: Administrators should have access to platform-wide financial audit trails, fraud flags, and operational analytics.

NFR-002.statement: The system should enforce role-based access control across shoppers, merchants, warehouse staff, and admins.

NFR-003.statement: Customers and merchants must only have access to their own data and transaction histories.

FR-032.statement: The notification service should dispatch real-time alerts for order confirmation, shipping updates, and refunds.

NFR-004.statement: All security-sensitive operations including password resets and financial adjustments should be logged in an audit trail.
